_note: Massed conscript infantry backed by armor. Cheap bodies, poor Mettle, wins by weight of numbers and heavy weapons. Points are formula-derived; edit stats, not costs.
_v05_status: Partial re-price 2026-09-29 (path-to-playtest-2026-09-28.md Phase 3, watered-down slice): Rifle Squad, Veteran Squad, Scout Element, Armored Personnel Carrier, Armored Fighting Vehicle are updated to the v0.5 formula (Evasion archetype-locked, Wounds key, CCW, extras/modifiers split for named traits) -- see each unit's own _v05_note. Regimental Officer, Conscript Mob, Storm Squad, Heavy Weapons Team, Field Gun Battery, and Tank Destroyer are UNTOUCHED and still d10-era stale (old Evasion tuning, 'toughness' key, ungated free rules like Leadership Aura/Entrenched/Brutal Assault/Where We're Needed that SS11 Step 5 now prices as 'extras') -- do not treat their point costs as current.
_faction_trait_note: Regiments currently has no faction-wide signature trait -- Massed Ranks moved to being the Infantry Platoon's CORE bonus instead (design-bible.md SS8, Round 3, 2026-09-28), gated on Platoon selection + CORE + Infantry keyword, not a blanket per-unit multiplier. build_cat.py auto-applies a truthy top-level faction_trait to every unit >= its min_size, so leaving the old block in place here silently over-charged Rifle Squad and Veteran Squad (both >=8 models) with a bonus that's no longer faction-wide. A real replacement signature trait for Regiments is still deliberately deferred (Outstanding Work, path-to-playtest-2026-09-28.md). Massed Ranks itself, for whenever Platoons get modeled in this JSON: 'While a CORE, Infantry-keyword unit in the Infantry Platoon holds 8+ models, it re-rolls Attack Rolls of 1 and gains +1 Mettle.'
_weapon_tiers: Tier 1 Infantry (man-portable) / Tier 2 Crew-served (team or vehicle secondary mount) / Tier 3 Vehicular-Towable (needs a hull or carriage). See design-bible.md and reference.html for the full breakdown and reasoning.

Surplus Rifle._note: Levy issue: carbine range, rifle stats otherwise -- old stock, not a worse gun

Scout Rifle._note: Ranger issue, replaces Scout Autogun. Not a full sniper's weapon, just longer legs than a standard Rifle.

CCW._note: Replaces Fists. Flat 0pts by decision (design-bible.md SS11) -- exists solely to give a unit a melee option.

Bayonet._note: Superseded by CCW on Fusilier/Grenadier -- kept in the library, unused, pending the rest of the roster's re-price.

Combat Knife._note: Superseded by CCW on Ranger -- kept in the library, unused, pending the rest of the roster's re-price.

Marksman Rifle._note: OPTICS now has a real mechanism (design-bible.md glossary: ignores Evasion bonuses from Obscured/Obscuring terrain) but still has no pricing tier assigned in points.py. Priced at 0 until it does; do not treat this weapon's cost as final.

weapons._comment_tier2: -- Tier 2: Crew-served (team-operated, or a vehicle's secondary/hull mount) --

Missile Launcher._note: Ballistier keeps this -- flexible generalist, not the sharpest AT punch in the faction.

Heavy ATGM._note: Hunter's dedicated tier -- outclasses Ballistier's Missile Launcher specifically against armor (AP7/D7 vs AP4/D5), no Blast/Guided/Indirect flexibility. Does one job better than anything else in the faction.

Mortar._note: Infantry-portable indirect fire, distinct from the towed Field Howitzer: shorter range and smaller punch, but no Towable slot needed.

weapons._comment_tier3: -- Tier 3: Vehicular / Towable (needs a hull or a carriage) --

MLRS._note: Area saturation, not precision -- answers a dug-in infantry blob, not a tank.

weapons._comment_legacy: -- kept in the library but no longer assigned to any built unit --

units.name: Rifle Squad
units._v05_note: Re-priced 2026-09-29, watered-down Regiments playtest slice (path-to-playtest-2026-09-28.md Phase 3). Evasion locked to the Infantry archetype (design-bible.md SS3 -- veterancy no longer differentiates through Evasion); Bayonet -> CCW; Boots on the Ground retired outright (SS7); Entrenched moved from free 'rules' into a priced 'extras' entry (SS11 Step 5). This is the anchor unit -- its own chassis+weapons cost is the formula's 100pt calibration point.

units.name: Veteran Squad
units._v05_note: Re-priced 2026-09-29, same pass as Rifle Squad. Evasion locked to the Infantry archetype -- veterancy differentiates through Mettle (4->5) and equipment (Plasma Rifle/LMG upgrades) instead, per design-bible.md SS3's explicit instruction.

modifiers.name: Conscript
modifiers.text: This unit may never re-roll a die for any reason, and may not take the Rally action.

units.name: Scout Element
units._v05_note: Re-priced 2026-09-29. Evasion 6 is a deliberate archetype pick -- design-bible.md SS3's 'Elite / dedicated dodge specialist' row, not a veterancy tweak (which the same section explicitly rules out) -- a scout's whole job is not getting hit. Spotter/Camouflaged/All-Terrain moved from free 'rules' (the old RECON-Role automatic grant, retired SS7) into priced 'extras' -- these are now things Ranger was individually built with, not a Role bonus.

units.name: Armored Personnel Carrier
units._v05_note: Re-priced 2026-09-29. Stats match Marten's canonical Medium Chassis line (faction-identity.md: Spd8/Met4/Eva5/Arm6/W9 -- Evasion5 sits at the Light Vehicle archetype's upper edge, design-bible.md SS3). Armored Front and Hardpoints are no longer automatic from the Vehicle keyword (SS7) -- Armored Front now prices as a Step-3 weapon-tier-style unit modifier (Minuscule bonus, x1.05), Hardpoints moved into priced 'extras' (Minor). Open-Topped is free fluff text (Marten's un-upgraded default, no Protection package taken), not a costed trait.

units.name: Armored Fighting Vehicle
units._v05_note: Re-priced 2026-09-29, treated as Regiments' MBT/generalist gun-tank for this playtest slice (faction-identity.md's Fisher -- the only Medium Chassis vehicle that flips to Role ARMOR). Evasion dropped to 3, the Heavy Vehicle archetype's upper edge (design-bible.md SS3) -- Fisher is 'noticeably slower than Sable' and harder to juke than the Bus/Gunboat pair, not a light-vehicle dodge profile. Speed/Armor/Wounds nudged off the shared Medium baseline (Spd7/Arm7/W10) to reflect that same divergence, per faction-identity.md's own note that Fisher was always the vehicle most likely to break the shared-profile pattern first. Mettle held flat at the family-wide 4 -- faction-identity.md is explicit that crew training doesn't scale with hull weight. Armored Front/Hardpoints re-priced the same way as the APC; Bulwark (ARMOR-Role pairing, SS7) moved from free 'rules' into priced 'extras' (Major).
